myReference: I hosted Asiye from Turkey and her friend for one night. They arrived quite late due to their flight to Bogotá and were understandably very tired, but still friendly and willing to talk. I recommended them a good place to buy Colombian coffee, which they appreciated. They were kind, clean, respectful, and overall great couchsurfers. Everything went smoothly and I would be happy to host them again.

theirReference: We stayed at Cristian’s home for 3 days, Cristian provided us a separate room with a bathroom, his family and the dog were adorable. Cristian is friendly, respectful young man. We felt completely safe during our stay. The neighbourhood and the house are very authentic and something special , it is at the south of Bogota, which i find it very interesting. It was definitely different aspect of Colombia and it was good experience overall staying with a local family. There is also rooftop you can see the city above. Cristian thanks a lot for your efforts and wish you the best travels furthermore ☺️
myReference: Ayse stayed with her friend and was a wonderful guest, very kind and genuinely interested in learning about the local culture. She was very clean and respectful at all times. Communication was always smooth, and she followed all the house rules. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ She is an easygoing person with a great vibe. 😇 I truly appreciate the lovely gift she brought from Germany, such a thoughtful detail. ❤️ Hosting her was definitely a great experience, and I would happily recommend her to any future host. 🤗💫 Seni tanıdığıma çok memnun oldum, umarım tekrar görüşürüz :)
